Fixed! The bug was in invoice.js:97f15ed at line 11. The refactor commit (a935b0c) accidentally removed the discount amount from the tax calculation. When tax should be calculated on `(subtotal - discount)`, the modernization changed it to just `subtotal`. This made invoices with discount codes come out higher than they should because the tax was being applied to the full amount instead of the discounted amount.

The fix restores the original behavior—tax is now correctly applied to the discounted subtotal. All 250 tests pass, including the critical test for SPRING10 discount code validation.
